sections.Aims and Fit of Module: To equip students with theories and knowledge required to address important issues in neighbourhood planning • To develop a student’s appreciation of the importance of planning at the neighbourhood scale for a diverse society • To enable students to employ basic research and planning methods at the neighborhood scale
sections.Learning outcomes: A. critically discuss issues of neighbourhood planning B. understand the importance of planning at the neighbourhood scale for a diverse society C. utilize methods learned in this course to identify local neighbourhood needs D. demonstrate relevant skills in neighbourhood planning
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The module comprises lectures, tutorials and workshops.
